simple.prompt: Logical deduction about past certainty: 'The streets are completely soaked; it ___ rained heavily last night.'
simple.explanation: 'Must have + V3' menyatakan kesimpulan logis yang hampir pasti benar mengenai peristiwa masa lalu.
hints: Kesimpulan pasti atas bukti basah kuyup.

simple.prompt: Logical deduction about past impossibility: 'He ___ committed the theft; he was live on national television at that exact time.'
simple.explanation: 'Can't have + V3' (atau couldn't have) menyatakan ketidakmungkinan logis di masa lampau.
hints: Ketidakmungkinan mutlak masa lalu karena ada alibi kuat.

simple.targetSentence: You should have listened to the doctor's advice.
simple.explanation: You should have listened + to the doctor's advice.

simple.prompt: Past possibility: 'I can't find my keys anywhere. I ___ left them on the train.'
simple.explanation: 'Might have / may have / could have + V3' menyatakan kemungkinan peristiwa masa lampau yang tidak pasti.

simple.targetSentence: He could have passed the exam if he had studied.
simple.explanation: He could have passed the exam + if he had studied.
hints: Peluang masa lalu yang tidak terealisasi: 'He could have passed the exam'.

simple.prompt: Criticism about unfulfilled duty: 'The project team ___ the final draft yesterday, but they failed to do so.'
simple.explanation: 'Should have + V3' menyatakan kewajiban masa lalu yang seharusnya dilakukan namun tidak terlaksana.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat deduksi negatif 'couldn't have known'.
simple.targetSentence: She couldn't have known about the surprise party.
simple.explanation: She couldn't have known + about the surprise party.

simple.prompt: The reception desk is completely dark — everyone ___ gone home already.
simple.explanation: Kesimpulan logis yang sangat yakin mengenai peristiwa masa lalu memakai Modal Perfect: 'must have + V3 (gone)'.
hints: Deduksi kuat masa lalu memakai 'must have'.

simple.prompt: That email ___ come from our IT director; she never writes without a signature block.
simple.explanation: Ketidakmungkinan logis tentang kejadian di masa lalu memakai 'can't have + V3' atau 'couldn't have + V3' (BUKAN 'mustn't have').

simple.prompt: You ___ checked the passport expiration date before booking the non-refundable ticket.
simple.explanation: Saran penyesalan atau kritik atas kelalaian di masa lalu memakai 'should have + V3' ('seharusnya dulu kamu mengecek...').
hints: Menyatakan penyesalan/kritik bahwa hal itu seharusnya dilakukan.

simple.prompt: I don't see Riko's backpack anywhere; he ___ left for the studio early.
simple.explanation: Spekulasi/kemungkinan masa lalu yang belum pasti (~50%) memakai 'might have', 'may have', atau 'could have + V3'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang penyesalan atau kesalahan yang terlanjur dilakukan.
dialogue: Supervisor
Why did the backup file overwrite yesterday's sales ledger?
Intern
I'm sorry — I ___ clicked 'Replace' instead of 'Save As'.
simple.explanation: Mengakui tindakan masa lalu yang seharusnya TIDAK dilakukan memakai 'shouldn't have + V3'.
hints: Dia terlanjur mengklik 'Replace' padahal itu keliru.

simple.prompt: We ___ have missed the turnoff; none of these street signs match our map.
simple.explanation: Kesimpulan pasti atas kesalahan arah berdasarkan bukti di sekitar ('none of these street signs match') memakai 'must have + V3'.
hints: Bukti rambu jalan memastikan mereka memang salah belok.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan mengganti 'have' dengan 'of' pada konstruksi Modal Perfect berikut.
simple.draft: Our courier should of verified the apartment number before leaving the crate downstairs.
options: Our courier should have verified the apartment number before leaving the crate downstairs.
Our courier should has verified the apartment number before leaving the crate downstairs.
Our courier should had verified the apartment number before leaving the crate downstairs.
simple.explanation: 'Should of' adalah kesalahan ejaan dari pelafalan cepat 'should've'; bentuk tulisan baku wajib memakai 'should have + V3'.
hints: Jangan pernah menulis 'should of' atau 'would of'.

simple.prompt: They ___ brought extra umbrellas because it didn't rain at all, though it was thoughtful of them.
simple.explanation: 'Needn't have + V3' berarti tindakan itu terlanjur dilakukan meskipun belakangan ternyata tidak perlu.
hints: Mereka sudah terlanjur membawa payung padahal tidak hujan.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat deduksi mustahil masa lalu memakai 'couldn't have'.
simple.targetSentence: A novice hacker couldn't have bypassed our encrypted firewall alone.
simple.explanation: 'Couldn't have + V3 (bypassed)' menyatakan ketidakmungkinan mutlak di masa lalu.
hints: Awali dengan 'A novice hacker couldn't have bypassed'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat penyesalan kritik masa lalu memakai 'should have'.
simple.targetSentence: The contractor should have tested the drainage slope before pouring concrete.
simple.explanation: Subject + should have + V3 ('tested') + objek + klausa waktu.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The contractor should have tested'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog perbedaan 'needn't have done' (melakukan hal yang tak perlu) vs 'didn't need to do'.
dialogue: Colleague
I spent the entire weekend reformatting the legacy database.
Lead Engineer
You ___ that; our new automated migration tool does it in three minutes!
intermediate.explanation: 'Needn't have done' digunakan ketika seseorang sudah terlanjur melakukan suatu pekerjaan yang ternyata tidak diperlukan.
hints: Pekerjaan sudah terlanjur dilakukan padahal sia-sia.

intermediate.prompt: Difference: 'We didn't need to purchase the tickets' means...
options: We knew it was not necessary, so we did not purchase them.
We purchased them, but later discovered it was unnecessary.
We were forced to purchase them.
intermediate.explanation: 'Didn't need to do' berarti subjek tahu hal tersebut tidak perlu, sehingga aksi tersebut TIDAK dilakukan sama sekali.
hints: Aksi tidak dilakukan karena sudah tahu tidak perlu.
Pilih opsi 'we did not purchase them'.

intermediate.prompt: Past desire/willingness that was thwarted: 'I ___ to help you with the renovation, but I was out of town.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Would have liked to + V1' menyatakan keinginan masa lalu yang tidak bisa diwujudkan.
hints: Keinginan masa lalu yang terhalang keadaan.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat deduksi ketidakmungkinan dengan 'can't have stolen'.
intermediate.targetSentence: He can't have stolen the necklace because he was abroad.
intermediate.explanation: He can't have stolen the necklace + because he was abroad.
hints: Deduksi negatif: 'He can't have stolen the necklace'.

intermediate.prompt: May have vs Might have: In speculative academic analysis, both indicate past probability, but 'may have' often implies...
options: a slightly higher degree of epistemic likelihood than 'might have'
that the action is in the present
intermediate.explanation: 'May have' secara epistemik sering mengindikasikan tingkat kemungkinan yang sedikit lebih tinggi daripada 'might have'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat penyesalan negatif 'should not have said'.
intermediate.targetSentence: I should not have said those hurtful words to her.
intermediate.explanation: I should not have said + those hurtful words to her.
hints: Mulai dengan penyesalan negatif: 'I should not have said'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'those hurtful words to her'.

dialogue: Analyst
Did the venture fund anticipate the sudden regulatory ban?
Partner
They ___ the warning signs in the preliminary draft.
intermediate.explanation: 'Ought to have + V3' setara dengan 'should have + V3' untuk menyatakan evaluasi moral atau kewajiban analitis masa lalu.

intermediate.prompt: Compare carefully: 'We didn't buy bottled water because the hotel provided glass carafes' → 'We ___ buy bottled water' vs 'I bought three boxes unnecessarily' → 'I ___ bought three boxes.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Didn't need to + V1' berarti tidak perlu dan memang TIDAK dilakukan; 'needn't have + V3' berarti tidak perlu tetapi SUDAH TERLANJUR dilakukan.
hints: Aksi 1 memang batal dibeli ('didn't buy'); aksi 2 terlanjur dibeli.
Cocokkan V1 ('didn't need to buy') vs V3 ('needn't have bought').

intermediate.prompt: I ___ have sent you the full report earlier, but my laptop refused to connect to hotel Wi-Fi.
intermediate.explanation: 'Would have + V3' (tanpa if-clause eksplisit, diikuti 'but...') menyatakan keinginan/kesediaan di masa lalu yang terhalang kendala nyata.
hints: Keinginan/kesediaan yang terhalang kendala di masa lalu.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan mengenai perbedaan 'must have' (deduksi) vs 'had to' (kewajiban).
dialogue: HR
Why didn't Marco join Friday's team dinner?
Colleague
He told me he ___ catch an emergency night flight to Medan for a client issue.
intermediate.explanation: Untuk menyatakan KEWAJIBAN/KEHARUSAN nyata di masa lalu ('terpaksa mengejar penerbangan'), gunakan 'had to + V1', BUKAN 'must have + V3' (yang berfungsi untuk tebakan/deduksi).
hints: Konteksnya fakta kewajiban yang diceritakan langsung ('He told me...'), bukan tebakan.

intermediate.prompt: Look at the degrees of certainty: which modal perfect expresses the WEAKEST level of speculation (~20-40%) about what happened?
options: The cable might have loosened during transit.
The cable must have loosened during transit.
The cable can't have loosened during transit.
intermediate.explanation: 'Might have' / 'may have' / 'could have' menyatakan kemungkinan terbuka (<50%), jauh lebih lemah tingkat kepastiannya dibanding deduksi kuat 'must have' (~95%) atau mustahil 'can't have' (~0%).
hints: Bedakan spekulasi ragu-ragu ('might') vs kepastian logis ('must' / 'can't').

intermediate.prompt: The vendor ___ have informed customs about the lithium batteries beforehand; neglecting that rule caused the hold.
intermediate.explanation: 'Ought to have + V3' sama maknanya dengan 'should have + V3' untuk menyatakan kewajiban moral/profesional yang terlewat di masa lalu.
hints: Perhatikan 'have informed' dan akibat buruk kelalaian.
Padanan 'should have' yang memakai 'to' adalah 'ought to have'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum menyatukan 'mustn't have' untuk deduksi negatif masa lalu berikut.
intermediate.draft: Given her strict safety training, Elena mustn't have unplugged the main server rack deliberately.
options: Given her strict safety training, Elena couldn't have unplugged the main server rack deliberately.
Given her strict safety training, Elena mustn't unplugged the main server rack deliberately.
Given her strict safety training, Elena didn't must have unplugged the main server rack deliberately.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris standar, 'mustn't have' TIDAK digunakan untuk menyimpulkan ketidakmungkinan logis di masa lalu; gunakan 'can't have' atau 'couldn't have'.
hints: Ganti 'mustn't have' yang keliru menjadi deduksi mustahil 'couldn't have' / 'can't have'.

intermediate.prompt: Notice counterfactual risk: 'Slow down on wet curves — you ___ have skidded straight into that barrier!'
intermediate.explanation: 'Could have + V3' menyatakan risiko nyata di masa lalu yang berpotensi terjadi andaikan tidak berhati-hati ('tadi kamu bisa saja tergelincir!').
hints: Kecelakaan tidak terjadi, tetapi nyaris terjadi.
Potensi bahaya lampau yang terhindarkan memakai 'could have + V3'.

intermediate.prompt: Wait — our office keys are missing! No one ___ entered without a security pass unless a door was propped open.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam kalimat negatif 'No one...', pasangkan 'could have + V3' (= 'No one could have entered...' = tidak mungkin ada yang bisa masuk).

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat keinginan lampau tak terwujud dengan 'would have' + 'but'.
intermediate.targetSentence: I would have joined the maritime field trip, but I caught a fever.
intermediate.explanation: 'Would have + V3' menyatakan niat lampau yang urung akibat klausa penghalang 'but...'.
hints: Awali dengan 'I would have joined the maritime field trip,'.
Akhiri dengan 'but I caught a fever'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pembeda 'didn't need to' (memang tidak dilakukan).
intermediate.targetSentence: We didn't need to print extra brochures because the venue provided QR tablets.
intermediate.explanation: Fakta memang tidak dicetak karena tidak diperlukan memakai 'didn't need to + V1'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'We didn't need to print extra brochures'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kerancuan antara 'must have' dan past obligation 'had to'.
complex.draft: I didn't answer your call because I must have rushed my daughter to the hospital.
options: I didn't answer your call because I had to rush my daughter to the hospital.
I didn't answer your call because I should have rushed my daughter to the hospital.
I didn't answer your call because I would have rushed my daughter to the hospital.
complex.explanation: Untuk menyatakan kewajiban/keharusan nyata di masa lalu (past necessity/obligation), gunakan 'had to'. 'Must have + V3' HANYA untuk tebakan/deduksi logis, bukan kewajiban nyata.
hints: Menyatakan keharusan nyata masa lalu, bukan tebakan.

complex.prompt: Select the epistemic modal structure with passive voice: 'The confidential blueprint ___ by an unauthorized operative.'
complex.explanation: Modal Perfect Passive: modal + have been + V3 ('must have been leaked').
hints: Deduksi masa lalu pasif: must have been + V3.

complex.prompt: Subtle semantic contrast: 'She may have arrived' vs 'She might have arrived'. If the speaker believes it is completely counterfactual (she did NOT arrive):
options: Only 'might have' or 'could have' can express counterfactual unfulfilled events.
Only 'may have' can express counterfactual unfulfilled events.
Both are identical in counterfactual contexts.
complex.explanation: Hanya 'might have' dan 'could have' yang dapat digunakan untuk situasi kontrafaktual yang sudah diketahui tidak terjadi sama sekali. 'May have' selalu menyisakan kemungkinan terbuka bahwa peristiwa itu memang terjadi.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat deduksi pasif 'might have been intercepted'.
complex.targetSentence: The diplomatic transmission might have been intercepted by foreign intelligence.
complex.explanation: The diplomatic transmission + might have been intercepted + by foreign intelligence.
hints: Pasif modal perfect: 'might have been intercepted by foreign intelligence'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan bentuk kata kerja setelah modal perfect.
complex.draft: They couldn't have went to the museum because it was closed on Mondays.
options: They couldn't have gone to the museum because it was closed on Mondays.
They couldn't have go to the museum because it was closed on Mondays.
They couldn't had gone to the museum because it was closed on Mondays.
complex.explanation: Setelah 'couldn't have', kata kerja WAJIB berwujud Past Participle (V3), yaitu 'gone', BUKAN V2 'went'.

complex.prompt: Which modal perfect structure conveys indignant disbelief about someone's past audacity?
options: How could you have thought such a terrible thing?
How must you have thought such a thing?
How should you have thought such a thing?
complex.explanation: 'How could you have + V3?' adalah ekspresi baku kemarahan atau ketidakpercayaan atas kelancangan tindakan seseorang di masa lalu.
hints: Ekspresi ketidakpercayaan/kejengkelan: How could you have...?

dialogue: CISO
Could an external hacker have bypassed the dual firewall?
Lead Architect
Without valid credentials, they ___ accessed the root directory.
complex.explanation: 'Could not possibly have + V3' menekankan ketidakmungkinan mutlak secara logis dan teknis.

complex.prompt: Select the Modal Perfect Passive sentence that accurately diagnoses a past failure:
options: Two structural rivets must have been damaged during the offshore loading.
Two structural rivets must have damaged during the offshore loading.
Two structural rivets should be damaged during the offshore loading yesterday.
complex.explanation: Modal Perfect Passive memakai rumus: Modal ('must') + 'have been' + V3 ('damaged'). Tanpa 'been', 'must have damaged' bermakna aktif yang tidak masuk akal bagi paku keling.
hints: Paku keling mengalami kerusakan (pasif), bukan merusak.
Rumus Modal Perfect Passive: modal + have been + V3.

complex.prompt: How does 'How could you have ignored such an obvious warning light?' function pragmatically compared to a neutral deduction?
options: It expresses shock, disbelief, or strong moral reproach
It calmly measures statistical probability below 10%
It describes a routine scheduled action in the future
complex.explanation: 'How could + Subject + have + V3...?' adalah bentuk retoris khas untuk mengungkapkan rasa tak percaya yang dalam atau teguran keras atas tindakan seseorang di masa lalu.
hints: Nada kalimat 'How could you have...?' bernuansa emosional.
Fungsinya bukan netral, melainkan ekspresi disbelief/reproach.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggunaan 'needn't have' vs 'shouldn't have' yang membalik maksud kalimat berikut.
complex.draft: Because the confidential spreadsheet leaked online, the analyst needn't have shared that temporary link in a public forum.
options: Because the confidential spreadsheet leaked online, the analyst shouldn't have shared that temporary link in a public forum.
Because the confidential spreadsheet leaked online, the analyst didn't need to shared that temporary link in a public forum.
Because the confidential spreadsheet leaked online, the analyst mustn't have shared that temporary link in a public forum.
complex.explanation: Membagikan tautan rahasia ke forum publik adalah KESALAHAN fatal (seharusnya tidak dilakukan: 'shouldn't have shared'), BUKAN sekadar hal sepele yang mubazir ('needn't have').
hints: Bedakan 'tidak perlu/mubazir' ('needn't have') vs 'salah besar/dilarang' ('shouldn't have').
Kebocoran data adalah kesalahan serius, pakai 'shouldn't have'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan teknis memakai Modal Perfect Continuous Passive / Active.
dialogue: Inspector
Why were the bearings overheated when we opened Housing 3?
Engineer
Dust particles ___ into the lubricant seal for weeks before the failure.
complex.explanation: Menyimpulkan aktivitas proses yang pasti berlangsung terus-menerus ('for weeks') sebelum kegagalan lampau memakai Modal Perfect Continuous: 'must have been + V-ing (leaking)'.
hints: Durasi 'for weeks' sebelum kejadian lampau membutuhkan aspek continuous.

complex.prompt: Even if the night ferry had departed on schedule, passengers ___ arrived before the storm hit the harbor.
complex.explanation: Klausa hasil Third Conditional untuk ketidakmampuan atau kemustahilan lampau memakai 'couldn't have + V3' (bukan 'would can't').
hints: Bentuk modal sempurna negatif dari 'can' adalah 'couldn't have'.

complex.prompt: Notice this nuance: 'He ___ finished early — wait, his coat is still on the chair, so he ___ left the building yet!'
complex.explanation: Klausa pertama berspekulasi lembut ('may have finished early'), lalu penemuan bukti fisik jaketnya membuat pembicara langsung memastikan ia belum pergi ('can't have left yet').
hints: Jaket masih di kursi berarti mustahil dia sudah meninggalkan gedung ('can't have').

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menyatukan 'had' setelah 'ought to' pada kritik kebijakan berikut.
complex.draft: The municipal transit authority ought to had upgraded those aging signal relays last summer.
options: The municipal transit authority ought to have upgraded those aging signal relays last summer.
The municipal transit authority ought had upgraded those aging signal relays last summer.
The municipal transit authority ought to upgrading those aging signal relays last summer.
complex.explanation: Setelah semi-modal 'ought to', auxiliary untuk bentuk lampau sempurna tetap selalu 'have' ('ought to have upgraded'), tidak pernah 'had'.

complex.prompt: Rare archival footage ___ been lost forever had the volunteer team not digitized the reels in 2018.
complex.explanation: Klausa kedua ('had the volunteer team not digitized...') adalah inversi Third Conditional; oleh sebab itu klausa hasilnya memakai 'would have + V3 (would have been lost)'.
hints: Perhatikan inversi Third Conditional di bagian belakang kalimat.
Pasangkan hasil Modal Perfect Passive 'would have been lost'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat Modal Perfect Passive untuk kritik prosedur yang terlewat.
complex.targetSentence: Those expired fire extinguishers ought to have been replaced before last month's audit.
complex.explanation: Modal Perfect Passive: ought to + have been + V3 ('replaced').
hints: Awali dengan 'Those expired fire extinguishers ought to have been'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat ungkapan keterkejutan dengan 'How could... have'.
complex.targetSentence: How could the shipping clerk have misread such bold hazardous-cargo labels?
complex.explanation: 'How could + S + have + V3' menyuarakan rasa tidak percaya yang kuat atas keteledoran lampau.
hints: Mulai dengan 'How could the shipping clerk have misread'.
